notes.title: Surabaya Inferno 2022 big update!
notes.notes:
Dear everyone

It has been more than 2 year Surabaya Inferno released.

Now its time for this game got big update
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38577247/2b75e0845804e74b284d05e581e56ac357508bd4.png
[New cover for Surabaya Inferno]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38577247/4ed49d8117a93d41926ca16363e08eff3c24db9d.png
The game style will become pixel since artist in charge for this game very good in pixel style
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38577247/155ac89ec3342143da9707b868519e301b7168d1.png[/img
screenshot latest progress for Surabaya Inferno

So what change beside graphics? There are new features but just improving the quality of gameplay Surabaya Inferno.

The game file in Steam still 2020 version. There take lot time to updating Surabaya Inferno since Sengkala Dev splited in our main project, Fall of Bali.

Thank you for your attention

notes.title: Surabaya Inferno First update
notes.notes:
After 1 week our game got released, this is good time to update our game.
There are many things that we fix and update 
List fixed

 In User Interface, there are no texts of units name and replaced with number of units.
now player can send units with 3 option button (we converting this texts to buttons). So you can send either with enter A,B, or C or just press in option.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38577247/0a5a07b750b2f827b3a56cb7ae1b43405a8a2390.png
 There are soundeffects when players send units 
 Now bofors sprite can change depend on there position of mouse
 Newest manual guide attached in game folder


Soon there are another update...
